evidence_items.explanation: PredictaBoard measures successes and failures and tests predictors that operate before the subject LLM receives an input. Its tested predictors leave almost no usable region above the discussed 95% accuracy threshold, supporting limited predictability in this setting without establishing universal impossibility.

receipt.public_excerpt: Models perform well at predicting P(IK) and partially generalize across tasks, though they struggle with calibration of P(IK) on new tasks.

evidence_items.explanation: The study predicts whether a model knows an answer without inspecting a proposed answer, showing that advance information is possible. It predates the target period and does not establish dependable prediction of human-task substitution across unfamiliar settings.
